g.text: RIVER BED - PIERS ON THE ENGRAVED OUTLINES
CROSS PLATE - FOAM SLOPES ON THE RIVER SIDE
River-gap girder bridge - one module box (cut 2: West + East), module height 70.09 mm
5mm Material or 1/4" Ply 0.22" Actual - cut 2 sets - assemble the East module as a mirror image (flip every part)
Purple... Adjust Kerf OUT Green... Adjust Kerf IN Red... Engrave or Delete, do not cut.
